The environment is quiet with a faint indoor room tone, ensuring that the dialogue remains the singular focus without any background music or distracting sound effects. (2) Following a hard cut, the audio shifts to the female voice on-screen. Her vocal delivery becomes significantly slower and more rhythmic, carrying a tone of calm disappointment. No music or incidental noise events interrupt the final punchline delivery.
